title: SWAN-Rx: Efficient and Bandwidth-Scalable Neural Reception for MIMO-OFDM
abstract: arXiv:2611.20058v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a Scalable Windowed Axial-attention Neural Receiver (SWAN-Rx) for multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. The receiver improves reception accuracy and reduces forward-pass computation while supporting frozen-weight reuse across bandwidth allocations and channel conditions. It combines a common resource-element representation of received observations and pilot context with alternating time-axis and local frequency-axis attention. Shared parameters and relative positional information permit soft detection across allocation lengths without inference-time parameter updates. At fixed subcarrier spacing, model configuration, and symbol count, bounded frequency neighborhoods give linear growth of forward-pass computation with bandwidth. tldr: 提出SWAN-Rx神经接收机，利用窗口化轴向注意力机制在MIMO-OFDM系统中实现高精度接收，支持冻结权重跨带宽复用，且计算量随带宽仅呈线性增长。
